description: Sep 8 2026: Houthi drone/missile attack on Aramco's Jazan refinery and Abha distribution centre

posts.text: Large fire visible at Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery after a reported Houthi drone and missile barrage. Separate white smoke column from an oil distribution centre in Abha. Saudi air defenses active over Khamis Mushait airbase as well. Dozens of drones reported in this wave.

Reuters flash: Houthis attacked Saudi Aramco's Jazan refinery with dozens of drones and missiles overnight, causing a large fire. Smoke also reported from an Aramco oil distribution centre in Abha, with Saudi air defenses active over Khamis Mushait.

Saudi energy ministry statement: the attack on Jazan caused a fire in a crude processing unit which has been brought under control; no casualties. Refinery output "partially reduced" while damage is assessed. First official confirmation of unit-level damage.
